svg.text: The gate and the CI lanes — one runs last, the other ran from the start
1.0.7.1 is sequential-last by design; 1.0.7.2 is fully parallel and guards every job it cannot yet run.
Gate · runs after every copy-landing subtask
Exit 1 on any byte difference, so a node-local copy can
never drift from its contracts/ source. Runs locally and
as a CI job — proving byte-identity survives a Linux checkout.
created by 1.0.7.2 — CI-only from day one
added by 1.0.2.1 — caches the Vanetza ASN.1 build
added by 5.0.8.2 — arm64 build + registry push
No registry-push credential existed when the workflow was written — flagged, not absorbed.
Three subtasks were recorded blocked before they were done: 1.0.2.5, 1.0.5.1 and 1.0.7.1 all waited on the golden-vector corpus
reaching the repository. The plan file carries each block as its own commit, then the unblocking as another.
